purpose: Test retention and retrieval of complete action sequences for alternating unfamiliar hidden-precondition tasks using opaque action roles and strict budgets
family: novel procedural simulator, independent of historical workshop/repair generators

generator.role_tokens: seed-specific opaque stable identifiers; public per-episode action aliases independently shuffled
generator.context_label: seed-opaque but stable; not the dependency structure
generator.graph_A: two leaves -> merge -> common goal, 4 required actions
generator.graph_B: three serial steps -> common goal, 4 required actions; disjoint non-goal prerequisite roles

models: context-indexed successful action-plan memory with online exploration fallback
single most recent success plan regardless of context
metrics: successes by model/seed, first20 and later60
mean accepted and blocked action attempts
coverage of both context skill slots
independent replay and rehashed mutation rejection
boundaries: No DAG, action graph, hidden prereq or simulator reward truth to learner API; terminal success and accepted/blocked feedback only
No privileged role semantics; stable role IDs and contexts remain engineered priors
No transfer to independently named third environment claimed
No retroactive protocol edits or hyperparameter tuning on test episodes
No real actions, automatic model promotion or AthenZ/Synveil permission
